title.value: A Multifaceted Framework to Evaluate Evasion, Content Preservation, and Misattribution in Authorship Obfuscation Techniques
title.justification: The title explicitly describes the multifaceted framework being evaluated in the context of authorship obfuscation techniques.
title.quote: A Multifaceted Framework to Evaluate Evasion, Content Preservation, and Misattribution in Authorship Obfuscation Techniques.

extractions.description: This paper evaluates authorship obfuscation techniques on their ability to hide the author's identity while preserving content. It introduces a new measure, misattribution harm, to evaluate the potential harm from detection evasion. The paper uses a competitive baseline, back translation, against state-of-the-art obfuscation techniques and highlights key weaknesses in these techniques.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on authorship obfuscation, which is aimed at anonymity and privacy rather than any direct environmental or eco-responsible application.
primary_category.quote: Authorship obfuscation is the task of masking the writing style of an author of a document to prevent authorship identification techniques from using stylistic patterns to reveal the author’s identity...

secondary_categories.justification: The study is centered around computational methodologies for authorship obfuscation without any specific consideration of environmentally responsible or sustainable applications.
secondary_categories.quote: Authorship obfuscation techniques have commonly been evaluated based on their ability to hide the author’s identity (evasion) while preserving the content of the original text.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category does not align with eco-responsible AI, focusing on applications of privacy and anonymization techniques instead.
primary_sub_category.quote: When a new authorship obfuscation technique is proposed, it is crucial to compare its effectiveness to state-of-the-art obfuscation tools.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper's content does not contribute to eco-friendly technologies or practices, but is rather about computational techniques for privacy.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Authorship obfuscation techniques aim to hide an author’s writing style which can be used by authorship identification tools to reveal the true identity of that author.

new_primary_category.justification: This category captures the paper's central focus on techniques for masking authorship and protecting identity in written documents.
new_primary_category.quote: Authorship obfuscation is the task of masking the writing style of an author of a document to prevent authorship identification techniques from using stylistic patterns to reveal the author’s identity...

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category reflects specific methods discussed in the paper, geared toward preventing the identification of authors through writing style analysis.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We use an authorship identification technique to evaluate the performance of authorship obfuscation...
